tools.name: facture_list_issuers
tools.description: List the issuers (emisores: the taxpayers that can stamp invoices) on this Facture account, with their RFC. Use an RFC to filter branches. Facture API: GET /emisor/find.

tools.name: facture_list_branches
tools.description: List the branches (sucursales) that can stamp invoices. Each branch id is the branch_id that facture_stamp_invoice needs. Pass issuer_rfc to show only one issuer's branches. Facture API: GET /sucursal/find.

tools.name: facture_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (receptores) in the account catalog: name, RFC, tax regime and address. Facture API: GET /cliente/find.

tools.name: facture_list_products
tools.description: List the products and services (conceptos) in the account catalog, with their unit prices and SAT keys. Facture API: GET /concepto/find.

tools.name: facture_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices (comprobantes) issued from this account: folio, series, total, receiver and cancelled flag. Facture API: GET /facturacion/find.

tools.name: facture_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one stamped invoice by its fiscal UUID: date, type, folio, currency, cancelled flag and totals. Facture API: GET /facturacion?id=<uuid>.

tools.name: facture_create_client
tools.description: Create a client (receptor) in the account catalog. The SAT requires the RFC, tax regime, CFDI use and a fiscal address. Creates a record only; it stamps nothing. Facture API: POST /cliente.

tools.name: facture_create_product
tools.description: Create a product or service (concepto) in the account catalog with a unit price in MXN and one IVA rate. Creates a record only; it stamps nothing. Facture API: POST /concepto.

tools.name: facture_stamp_invoice
tools.description: Stamp (timbrar) one CFDI invoice from a Facture JSON document, through the given branch. This issues a real tax invoice with the SAT and uses Facture credits: call it only after the user confirms every field. The stamped XML is left out of the reply; get it from Facture. Facture API: POST /timbrado/

tools.name: facture_cancel_invoice
tools.description: Cancel (cancelar) one stamped invoice with the SAT. Reason 01 means an error with a replacement invoice: it needs replacement_uuid. Reasons 02 to 04 need no replacement. Cancelling can need the receiver's approval; the reply says so. Facture API: POST /cancelacion.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: facture_stamp_invoice · Private data: facture_create_client, facture_create_product, facture_stamp_invoice · Public sink: facture_create_client, facture_create_product, facture_stamp_invoice, facture_cancel_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: facture_stamp_invoice · Private data: facture_create_client, facture_create_product, facture_stamp_invoice · Public sink: facture_create_client, facture_create_product, facture_stamp_invoice, facture_cancel_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
